name: Yuika-chan to Nobetsu Maku Nashi
original_name: 唯香ちゃんとのべつまくなし
source: Unlike most games of this kind, this game has real-time 3D graphics. It is possible to rotate and zoom the camera at most locations; however, there is no character movement of any kind. Sex scenes are mostly presented as looping pre-rendered videos; the player can choose various sexual positions and also view the movies from a different angle.
translation: 与大多数同类游戏不同，本作采用实时3D画面。在大多数场景中，玩家可以旋转和缩放镜头，但角色本身不会移动。性爱场景主要以循环播放的预渲染视频呈现，玩家可以选择不同的性交姿势，也能切换角度观看。
